name: Plate Armor of Etherealness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Etherealness
powers.text: Magic action: cast Etherealness (once per dawn); it lasts 10 minutes.

summary: Once a day, a Magic action casts Etherealness from it (10 minutes).
text: Once per dawn, the wearer can cast Etherealness from this armor as a Magic action. The spell ends after 10 minutes, when you take the armor off, or when you spend a Magic action to dismiss it.
